name: Helmer’s 7 Powers Brand Moat Matrix
diagnostic: Does our brand command a durable economic moat through Affective Valence (emotional affinity lowering price sensitivity) or Cognitive Shorthand (dramatically reducing customer search costs)?
artifact: An Affective Valence & Pricing Delta Audit evaluating brand pricing power against generic functional alternatives, distinct from network effects, switching costs, or counter-positioning.
trap: Mistaking short-term brand engagement or viral attention for an enduring economic pricing power moat.
pedigreeFull: Hamilton Helmer (*7 Powers: The Foundations of Business Strategy*, 2016).
